system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy

Emplacement Points:  0

A Backup Battery is a common safety precaution taken by all space travelers, but smugglers and pirates put it to even better use. A Backup Battery allows the ship to operate, at least its basic functions, for up to 1 hour after the ship's power generator fails. Additionally, if a ship is pushed to the bottom of the Condition Track by Ion damage, the ship's Engineer can make a DC 25 Mechanics check to reverse the ionization using the Backup Battery, moving the ship +1 step up the Condition Track. However, doing so drains the Backup Battery, which must then be replaced.
